column1: # English words must come out untouched (auto-restore on).
# Rows ending in a space also exercise commit-restore at the word break.
# "ie" English words (no đ, never transformed) must not be transformed.
# A telex tone key on a plain-vowel cluster (s→sắc, r→hỏi) is the English
# signature that gates the ie/ue transitional accept (regression: "user" → "ủe").
